warnings: hash_not_computed: exact-hash duplicate detection was run on normalised strings by inspection, not by a hashing tool. Re-run programmatically before freeze.

no_embedding_model: no fixed embedding model or version was available, so semantic similarity pairs were nominated by review rather than by vector distance. Nominated pairs were judged, never auto-deleted.

blinding_caveat: baseline visibility was never inspected, but generation and QA ran in the same context that had earlier read target pages. Deterministic term scanning was therefore applied to all 62 non-B0, non-competitor candidates, and passed.
gate_3_items_open: five decisions are routed to human_gate_3 and are not resolved here.

rule_catalog.note: All candidates carry variant role, text, language, locale, transformation, source IDs, grade, locale review status and provenance. prompt_hash is null everywhere and is recorded as a warning, not a per-candidate failure.
72 unique candidate IDs across 46 unique cells; every cell_spec_id, job_id, icp_id, persona_id and source_id resolves.

Normalised, token and edit-distance-1 scan for every entry in target_terms across all unaided and category_aided candidates. Zero hits. 'tracker' appears once, in prompt-005a, under the declared generic-word exception.
prompt-006a, prompt-016a, prompt-022a, prompt-031a use target aliases under the B0 exception; prompt-008a uses competitor names under the B1 competitor exception.
No candidate was written from an observed AI answer, ranking, mention list or target landing page.

NFKC clean, en-GB throughout, 5 to 34 words, single primary intent per candidate. Two-part questions (for example prompt-015a) were retained because both parts belong to one decision and one cited span.
Eleven pairs nominated for review; all retained as protected differences (see duplicate_review). None merged, none auto-deleted.

Every cell in the universe matches its architecture record; 33 unaided cells within the diagnostic band; aided, control and unaided partitions carry separate denominators; no cell claims a lane its band cannot support.
The only grade-D candidate (prompt-017a) is in a rotating cell.

No B3 or B4 candidate appends a purchase or supplier question. spec-042 and spec-044 ask for a recommendation because the cell is a B1 or B2 recommendation cell, not because a problem prompt was converted.
prompt-007a and prompt-007b attach to a dated primary regulator event with a review-by date. prompt-030a attaches to unverified commercial guidance and is quarantined.
